name: Short summarization
prompt: Summarize in exactly two bullet points: A neighborhood library extended its weekday hours after a six-month pilot. Evening visits rose by 35%, while weekend visits stayed about the same. The library will keep the new hours and survey residents next spring.

name: Simple reasoning
prompt: A team has 120 support requests. 25% are billing questions, and one third of the remaining requests are login issues. How many requests are neither billing nor login issues? Show the arithmetic briefly.

name: Structured extraction
prompt: Extract the following into JSON with keys "name", "date", and "action": 'Mina will send the revised budget to Omar by 2026-12-03.' Return only valid JSON.
